name: sapnet-aerobiology-dashboard
description: Weekly to annual pollen and fungal spore reporting dashboard for the SAPNET monitoring network.

scripts.check: for f in netlify/functions/*.js netlify/functions/lib/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && for f in public/assets/*.js; do node --input-type=module --check < "$f" || exit 1; done && echo 'all modules parse'
